incident-bot: ALERT: 3xx->5xx spike detected on inference-rw-prod-gpu across multiple zones. Automated mitigation attempt failed (cache eviction > 90%). Paging oncall.

Ari (oncall): reading... looks like prefix cache eviction rate jumped at 06:12 UTC, correlates with a batching config push at 05:58. Maya are you seeing the same traces?

Maya (SRE): yup. KV cache eviction log shows repeated "prefix-miss" churn. Notable: continuous-batch queue length doubled, tail latency spiked 600ms -> 1.8s. 

Devon (runtime): Repro from logs: prefix key hash changed for some templates after tokenizer upgrade. Sample log:
```
[2026-03-15T06:12:03Z] cache: prefix_hash( template_id=42 ) old=0x9a7f new=0x1b0f -> miss
[2026-03-15T06:12:04Z] kv: evict key=prefix:tpl:42, list_len=12000
```

Priya (ML): tokenizer v2.7 rolled to canary at 05:50; it changes whitespace mapping for templated prompts. That + a batching change (max_batch_tokens=4096 -> 8192) probably expanded cache keys and forced kv churn.

Ari (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) revert continuous-batching change, 2) temporarily disable prefix prefetch, 3) throttle background warmup. Who can roll the revert now?

Devon (runtime): I'm on it. Rolling back batching config on canaries, then prod. Command used:
```
rdctl rollout set inference.batch.max_tokens=4096 --env=prod --strategy=canary --timeout=10m
```

Maya (SRE): Also running a targeted prefix cache invalidation for known-bad templates to avoid full cache purge. Command:
```
rd cache invalidate --prefix=tpl:42 --confirm
```
Will monitor ripple.

incident-bot: DeployBot: rollback started by Devon; canary pass 2/3 -> promoting to prod.

Ari (oncall): customer impact: preliminary metrics show ~8% of requests for some customers returned 502/504 during spike window 06:12-06:28. CS notified via urgent channel. @PagerDuty can you escalate to account leads for 3 affected tenants?

PagerDuty: Escalation sent to accounts: BetaCo, EduApps, FinMate. Acknowledged by CS.

Priya (ML): For postmortem: hypothesis = tokenizer mismatch changed tokenization for templates and made prefix keys diverge, continuous-batching expansion increased latent working set causing rapid evictions. Need to pin tokenizer with backward-compatible mappings for templated prompts or include a key-compat shim.

Maya (SRE): Monitoring: eviction rate back to baseline after rollout, tail latency trending down. Still see some hot shards with cache pressure; running an on-the-fly compaction on those nodes.

Devon (runtime): Hotfix PR prepared to add a prefix_hash_version + tokenization fingerprint to avoid silent key drift. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3124

Ari (oncall): Handoff notes for next oncall (Maya -> Ari): summarize steps executed, RCA hypothesis, affected customers, mitigations performed, links to logs and PR. I'll run the handoff checklist now.

Ari (oncall): Handoff checklist:
- Incident id: infra-2312345678
- Root cause: tokenizer v2.7 + batching config change -> prefix key drift -> KV eviction spiral
- Actions taken: revert batching config, invalidate select prefixes, throttle prefetch, promote rollback
- Customer impact: ~8% errors for 3 tenants for ~16 minutes, error budget impact under P1 threshold; CS notified
- Followups: rollout PR #3124 for key versioning, add unit tests for tokenizer->prefix key compatibility, run canary template diff before tokenizer rollouts
- Postmortem owners: Priya (ML), Devon (runtime), Maya (SRE)

Maya (SRE): I'll take next oncall window responsibility for monitoring during recovery window. Set followup sync 60m. :thumbsup:

Priya (ML): logging task: generate diff snapshot of tokenization for all templated prompts pre/post v2.7 and share in PM notes.

Devon (runtime): also adding a temporary safeguard: if prefix cache eviction rate > 50% in 5m, gracefully disable prefetch and fall back to synchronous fetch to avoid OOM-like churn. PR queued.

Ari (oncall): thanks team. Will schedule postmortem and include customer impact summary for business. Closing incident channel once all followups are assigned.

incident-bot: Incident infra-2312345678 status -> resolved (mitigation applied).
